about: Pantry and allergen names, with what each implementation of the name rule makes of them. input: the raw name. clean: what both clients send (Android cleanWireName, iOS RecipeWire.cleanName), null when nothing is sent. allergen: the same for an allergen (cleanAllergenName), null when it can't be sent whole. server: normalizeName(input) in functions/src/core/inputSafety.ts, 'ok' or the rule; normalized: its normalised name when ok. cleanServer: normalizeName(clean), 'ok' (and then the name is unchanged) or a suspicious rule that cleaning deliberately does not rewrite. Checked by functions/test/nameFixture.test.ts (server), shared ServerNameRuleTest (Android, JVM) and iosApp/NameFixtureCheck/check.sh (iOS). lang: the language of a real product name.
